description: Support ticket triage (AI) — Triage a customer support ticket in one call: category (from your own list if given), priority P1-P4 with a reason, sentiment, what the customer wants, key details such as order ids and error messages, whether a human and escalation are needed, suggested team, tags, risk flags from keyword rules (legal threat, security, outage, payment dispute, churn risk, privacy request) and a short polite draft reply. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
